fusions.name: Run-Up Chop
fusions.desc: An overhead chop that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Hamstring Notch
fusions.desc: A darting cut at the legs that deals 7 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 25% for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Edge
fusions.desc: Hops you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your slashing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Culling Spree
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, your next strike has 30% more critical hit chance, once every 12 seconds. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
